g.text: Terminalsticker scan hier je code (abonnement of telefoon)
py-app-sticker-terminal-scan-code-abonnement | type sticker | trim 130.67 x 38.11 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: elf printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 130.67 x 38.11 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 136.67 x 44.11 mm.
Variabelen: text = Scan hier je code; text-of = of

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the source has only a 0.25 pt hairline as die line, no ThruCut contour. Radius measured on the die line, to be confirmed by the printer.

Text 'Scan hier je code' (Ubuntu 8.6 mm, code bold), 'of' (5.16 mm), subscription pass with barcode and phone with QR. Die line 0.5 pt. Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm
inside the trim and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token blue.
